title: Data Analyst Learning Roadmap
summary: A step‑by‑step guide to become a data analyst from scratch, covering essential tools, analytical techniques, and a portfolio to showcase your work. Follow the phases to build competence, create real projects, and prepare for job opportunities.

phases.title: Foundations
phases.summary: Build the basic literacy needed to work with data in everyday tools.

milestones.title: Spreadsheet Fundamentals
milestones.outcome: You can clean, transform, and visualize data using Excel or Google Sheets.

tasks.title: Watch Excel basics tutorial
tasks.description: Follow the official Microsoft Excel video series covering the interface and basic functions.

tasks.title: Create a sample budget sheet
tasks.description: Build a simple personal budget using formulas, tables, and conditional formatting.

tasks.title: Practice VLOOKUP and pivot tables
tasks.description: Use a provided sales CSV to extract totals with VLOOKUP and summarize with a pivot table.

tasks.title: Reflect on data cleaning steps
tasks.description: Write a short note on challenges you faced cleaning the sample data and how you resolved them.

milestones.title: SQL Basics
milestones.outcome: You can query relational databases to retrieve and filter data.

tasks.title: Read SQL introductory guide
tasks.description: Study the freeCodeCamp SQL Basics article covering SELECT, FROM, WHERE clauses.

tasks.title: Set up a local SQLite database
tasks.description: Install SQLite, create a database file, and load the sample dataset provided.

tasks.title: Write basic SELECT queries
tasks.description: Retrieve specific columns and rows from the sample tables using SELECT and WHERE.

tasks.title: Join two tables with INNER JOIN
tasks.description: Combine the sales and customers tables to list purchases with customer names.

tasks.title: Connect with a SQL community
tasks.description: Join the r/SQL subreddit and introduce yourself, asking a question about joins.

milestones.title: Introductory Statistics
milestones.outcome: You can describe data distributions and perform simple hypothesis tests.

tasks.title: Watch statistics fundamentals video
tasks.description: View Khan Academy’s introductory statistics playlist covering mean, median, variance.

tasks.title: Calculate descriptive stats in Sheets
tasks.description: Use built‑in functions to compute mean, median, standard deviation on a sample dataset.

tasks.title: Perform a t‑test in Google Sheets
tasks.description: Apply the TTEST function to compare two groups in the provided experiment data.

tasks.title: Summarize findings in a brief report
tasks.description: Write a one‑page summary interpreting the statistical results for a non‑technical audience.

tasks.title: Reflect on statistical assumptions
tasks.description: Note any assumptions you made during the t‑test and how they affect conclusions.

phases.title: Core Skills
phases.summary: Develop programming and visualization abilities to analyze data efficiently.

milestones.title: Python & pandas Essentials
milestones.outcome: You can load, clean, and analyze data using Python’s pandas library.

tasks.title: Complete pandas tutorial on freeCodeCamp
tasks.description: Follow the freeCodeCamp pandas guide covering DataFrames, indexing, and basic operations.

tasks.title: Set up a Python environment
tasks.description: Install Anaconda, create a new environment, and verify pandas is available.

tasks.title: Clean a messy CSV with pandas
tasks.description: Write code to handle missing values, rename columns, and parse dates in the sample file.

tasks.title: Aggregate data using groupby
tasks.description: Calculate total sales per region and month using pandas groupby and agg functions.

tasks.title: Reflect on Python workflow
tasks.description: Document the steps you took to clean the data and any challenges faced.

milestones.title: Data Visualisation Techniques
milestones.outcome: You can create clear, interactive charts to communicate insights.

tasks.title: Study chart best‑practice guide
tasks.description: Read the Data Visualization Handbook chapter on choosing appropriate chart types (free PDF).

tasks.title: Create a bar chart in matplotlib
tasks.description: Plot monthly sales from the cleaned dataset using matplotlib and label axes.

tasks.title: Build an interactive plot with Plotly
tasks.description: Convert the bar chart to an interactive Plotly figure and add hover info.

tasks.title: Design a dashboard in Tableau Public
tasks.description: Import the dataset into Tableau Public and assemble a dashboard with filters and charts.

tasks.title: Connect with a visualization forum
tasks.description: Post your dashboard on the Tableau Community Forums for feedback.

milestones.title: Storytelling with Data
milestones.outcome: You can craft narratives that turn analysis into actionable recommendations.

tasks.title: Read storytelling article on Storytelling with Data
tasks.description: Study Cole Nussbaumer Knaflic’s free blog post on the principles of data storytelling.

tasks.title: Write a data story outline
tasks.description: Draft an outline that includes context, analysis, visual, and recommendation for the sales data.

tasks.title: Create a slide deck in Google Slides
tasks.description: Translate the outline into a 5‑slide presentation with charts and concise text.

tasks.title: Practice presenting to a peer
tasks.description: Record a 3‑minute pitch of your deck and get feedback from a friend or online community.

tasks.title: Reflect on audience impact
tasks.description: Note how the story changed after feedback and what you would improve.

phases.title: Proof of Work
phases.summary: Apply your skills to real‑world projects that demonstrate your capabilities.

milestones.title: Sales Dashboard Project
milestones.outcome: You can deliver an end‑to‑end sales dashboard with insights and visualizations.

tasks.title: Select a public sales dataset
tasks.description: Download a sales dataset from Kaggle’s free public datasets collection.

tasks.title: Clean and prepare data in pandas
tasks.description: Use pandas to handle missing values, format dates, and create calculated fields.

tasks.title: Design key metrics visualizations
tasks.description: Create charts for revenue trends, top products, and regional performance using Plotly.

tasks.title: Assemble dashboard in Tableau Public
tasks.description: Combine the charts into an interactive Tableau dashboard with filters.

tasks.title: Write a project summary
tasks.description: Compose a one‑page write‑up describing methodology, findings, and business impact.

tasks.title: Publish and share portfolio link
tasks.description: Upload the dashboard and write‑up to your online portfolio and share on LinkedIn.

milestones.title: A/B Test Analysis Write‑up
milestones.outcome: You can evaluate experiment results and communicate conclusions effectively.

tasks.title: Find an A/B test dataset
tasks.description: Locate a free A/B test dataset on Kaggle or the Open Data portal.

tasks.title: Perform statistical analysis in Sheets
tasks.description: Calculate conversion rates, confidence intervals, and perform a chi‑square test.

tasks.title: Visualize test results with charts
tasks.description: Create side‑by‑side bar charts and a funnel diagram to illustrate outcomes.

tasks.title: Draft a concise report
tasks.description: Write a 2‑page report summarizing hypothesis, methodology, results, and recommendation.

tasks.title: Get feedback from a mentor
tasks.description: Share the report with a data‑analysis mentor on a forum and incorporate suggestions.

tasks.title: Reflect on analysis process
tasks.description: Note what you learned about experiment design and statistical testing.

phases.title: Getting Ready
phases.summary: Deepen expertise, learn advanced topics, and prepare for job or freelance opportunities.

milestones.title: Advanced SQL & Data Modeling
milestones.outcome: You can design efficient schemas and write complex queries for large datasets.

tasks.title: Study normalization concepts on MDN
tasks.description: Read MDN’s guide to database normalization and schema design.

tasks.title: Create a star schema in SQLite
tasks.description: Model a sales warehouse with fact and dimension tables using SQLite.

tasks.title: Write window functions queries
tasks.description: Implement ROW_NUMBER and SUM OVER partitions on the sample warehouse data.

tasks.title: Optimize query performance
tasks.description: Use EXPLAIN to analyze and improve query execution plans.

tasks.title: Connect with a data engineering group
tasks.description: Join a LinkedIn group focused on data engineering and ask about best practices.

tasks.title: Reflect on modeling choices
tasks.description: Document why you chose certain tables and keys in your schema.

milestones.title: Statistical Modeling & Machine Learning Basics
milestones.outcome: You can apply regression and classification models to business problems.

tasks.title: Watch introductory regression video on Khan Academy
tasks.description: Follow the video covering linear regression concepts and interpretation.

tasks.title: Implement linear regression in Python
tasks.description: Use scikit‑learn to fit a model on the sales dataset and evaluate R².

tasks.title: Validate model with cross‑validation
tasks.description: Apply K‑fold cross‑validation and interpret results.

tasks.title: Explain model to a non‑technical friend
tasks.description: Prepare a short explanation of the regression findings in plain language.

tasks.title: Join a data science meetup
tasks.description: Attend a virtual meetup session on beginner machine learning topics.

tasks.title: Reflect on model limitations
tasks.description: Write a brief note on assumptions and potential biases in your model.

milestones.title: Job & Freelance Readiness
milestones.outcome: You can market yourself, interview confidently, and land data analyst roles.

tasks.title: Update LinkedIn profile with projects
tasks.description: Add the three portfolio projects, skills, and a concise headline.

tasks.title: Craft a data analyst resume
tasks.description: Use a free resume template to highlight relevant experience and metrics.

tasks.title: Practice common interview questions
tasks.description: Answer five typical data analyst interview questions aloud and record yourself.

tasks.title: Prepare a 10‑minute case study presentation
tasks.description: Summarize one portfolio project as a live case study for interviews.

tasks.title: Network with industry professionals
tasks.description: Reach out to three data analysts on LinkedIn for informational chats.

tasks.title: Reflect on interview performance
tasks.description: After mock interviews, note strengths and areas to improve.
